subject: Orion private offer — implementation cadence & procurement checkpoints
messages:
From: Samuel Cho <samuel.cho@orionhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: private offer & billing cadence for marketplace purchase

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profile and the rollout options. Procurement asked me to get a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out: AWS private offer steps, what the PO needs to reference (account ID/billing contact), expected timeline for a 3-week evaluation, and the billing path once the private offer is accepted.

Can you send a one-page MAP and a checklist we can hand to our procurement/legal teams? Also, is DocuSign your preferred way to accept the PO?

Best,
Sam
Samuel Cho
Director, Cloud Integrations — Orion Health

Attachments: (none)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Cho <samuel.cho@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: private offer & billing cadence for marketplace purchase

Hi Sam — great to meet you yesterday.

Putting a short MAP together and attaching a draft so your procurement team can see the exact checkpoints. High-level:
- Week 0: Kickoff + technical onboarding (access to private offer in AWS marketplace)
- Week 1–3: POC evaluation (pre-agreed token/throughput targets)
- Week 3: Performance signoff + commercial PO issuance
- Post-sign: Redwood accepts private offer => AWS invoices Orion directly (billing path) or we can enable consolidated billing if preferred.

DocuSign works for the Redwood PO acceptance. I attached an editable MAP spreadsheet (Orion_MAP_draft.xlsx) with fields for AWS account ID and billing contact that procurement will need to complete.

Next step: if procurement sends the questions, Ben will own pricing/commit details and Lauren will coordinate legal redlines.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: Orion_MAP_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Cho <samuel.cho@orionhealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: private offer & billing cadence for marketplace purchase — pricing/commit notes

Sam — following up with the commercial specifics to plug into the MAP:
- Recommended plan: Reserved capacity private offer (3-month trial w/ option to convert to annual commit).
- Trial commit for POC: 100 token-concurrent capacity (SKU: R-INF-100).
- Pricing during trial: $0.045 /k token-second equivalent (we'll invoice via AWS once the private offer is accepted).

Notes on billing path:
1) Redwood publishes private offer via AWS Marketplace → Orion accepts the private offer in AWS Console.
2) Orion issues PO referencing the private offer ID and AWS Payer Account ID (we've included the field in the MAP).
3) Once Redwood accepts the PO in our DocuSign flow we confirm offer provisioning.
4) AWS issues the invoice to Orion per their standard cycle.

Attaching a small pricing CSV so procurement can map SKUs to their budgeting.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing_summary.csv (CSV)

Date: Mon, 03 Sep 2028 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: private offer & billing cadence for marketplace purchase — procurement questions

Hi Mina / Ben,

Procurement here. A couple of clarifying items before we can move to PO:
- PO needs to reference: AWS Private Offer ID, Redwood vendor ID, and ORION AWS Payer Account ID.
- Please confirm the billing contact and invoice delivery method (email vs AWS invoice).
- Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a minimum commit beyond the trial? If so, what are early-termination terms?
- We also need any standard procurement questionnaire answers (supply chain, sanctions).

I've attached our short procurement checklist so you can populate fields. If we can get answers by EOD Wednesday we'll target an internal approval the following week.

Thanks,
On behalf of Orion Procurement
procurement@orionhealth.com

Attachments: procurement_questions.pdf (PDF)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: procurement@orionhealth.com, Samuel Cho <samuel.cho@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Sep 2028 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: private offer & billing cadence for marketplace purchase — updated MAP + next steps

Hi — thanks, procurement. Quick answers inline and an updated MAP link below.

- Private Offer ID: will be provided in the final DocuSign package (we can add it as a field so the PO references it).
- Redwood Vendor ID: RW-INFERENCE-3395
- Billing contact: finance@redwood.com (we will ensure invoices are routed to your billing email).
- Minimum commit: no minimum beyond the agreed POC: trial is fully refundable; if you convert to a reserved plan we will capture the contract term in the DocuSign. Early-termination language is standard (30‑day notice + pro-rated refunds).

Attached is an updated MAP (same spreadsheet) with the suggested internal checklist and a 3-week evaluation cadence. Key milestone dates:
- Day 0: Provision private offer + IAM access for test accounts
- Day 2–10: Integration + baseline throughput tests
- Day 11–20: Load/quality validation against your sample prompts
- Day 21: Signoff / PO issuance

Fallback: if AWS private offer provisioning gets delayed, we will enable a hosted trial account and bill via pay-as-you-go so the POC still moves forward.

DocuSign link for PO acceptance (draft): https://docusign.com/REDWOOD-ORN-2028-005
HubSpot record: https://na1.app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/ORN-2028-005
SOC2 report (public): https://redwood-inference.com/security/soc2-report.pdf

I'll schedule a 30-minute call Friday to confirm the MAP and capture any legal redlines.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: Orion_MAP_draft.xlsx (updated)

Subject: Re: Request: private offer & billing cadence for marketplace purchase — PO redlines

Hi all,

From legal: we reviewed the draft PO and have a handful of small redlines (payment terms, data-retention audit clause, and SLA credits language). Please see attached PO_redline_v1.pdf.

Requests for Redwood:
- Confirm retention period for audit logs and whether logs can be exported to our SIEM.
- Provide SOC2 attestation (link above is helpful, but we may need the signed report).
- Clarify SLA credit calculation (we prefer a cap and defined remedy).

Happy to hop on a redline call — can your legal counsel join next Tuesday?

Thanks,
Elena Vargas
Senior Counsel — Orion Health
elena.vargas@orionhealth.com
